# Fix: false Fully error in the tablet check for tablets with the app; README update
### Fixed
- **The tablet check reported a false Fully error for tablets that run the Frameside app.** If a device still had a stored Fully address and password but the app was running, the check showed "Fully remote control is not reachable" as an error. When a device reports with the app, Fully is no longer queried at all.
### Documentation
- **README (English and German):** new strengths (tablet app with self-update, battery care, link for grandma, status in the device list, backup), a factual comparison with ImmichFrame and Immich Kiosk, and three new screenshots.

Update: `cd ~/immich-showcase && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. ☕ [ko-fi.com/frameside](https://ko-fi.com/frameside)
